name: t_two_attackers
note: The solver's hand-computed game. Seat 0 attacks with Centaur Courser (3/3) and Goblin Assailant (2/2); seat 1, at 2 life, has one untapped blocker (Walking Corpse, 2/2) and nothing else. The first decision is whether the Courser attacks. Attacking with both wins whatever it blocks (the other deals at least 2); the Assailant alone is blocked. So ATTACK is 1 and DECLINE is 0.
